A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MLP Memory research. Their complete main texts and appendices, including equations, tables and figures, support reliable comparison despite reformatting and section relocation.

before.justification: V2 reports original QA, general NLP, HaluEval, scaling, sensitivity and distribution-analysis results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V4 retains these empirical results and adds kNN-LM QA comparisons, token-level case studies and a memory-size ablation.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same hidden-state mapping, cached kNN targets with self-exclusion, hybrid KL/CE objective and probability interpolation. Newly documented initialization and dimensions in Appendix I do not establish a change to the underlying method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training corpora, five QA benchmarks, nine general NLP tasks, HaluEval tasks and WikiText-103/Web language-modeling evaluations. The new memory-size and token-level analyses reuse WikiText-103 next-token prediction without introducing distinct task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: V4 adds kNN-LM to Table 1's five-benchmark QA comparison for both Llama2 and Mistral. V2 already evaluates this comparator elsewhere, but its QA rows are absent. The other comparator memberships remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The new memory-size experiment holds GPT2-large fixed and varies memory depth across 8, 15 and 36 layers, with hidden/intermediate dimensions fixed at 1280/5120. Appendix H also introduces four target-token probability comparisons. Existing benchmark metrics and stated training budgets are retained.

E4.justification: Appendix J adds a controlled memory-capacity ablation beyond v2's joint backbone/memory scaling. Appendix H adds four rare-entity and function-word cases to investigate complementary prediction behavior. Existing loss, layer, interpolation, neighbor-count and target-distribution analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates and retain the same averages over 20,000 test samples in Tables 7–8. Neither introduces repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: New results include kNN-LM QA averages of 33.16 for Llama2 and 32.57 for Mistral, Table 10's token probabilities, and Table 13's memory-size perplexities of 11.41, 11.35 and 11.25 against a 15.81 base-model score. Retained benchmark scores, sensitivity values and scaling fits are unchanged; these are additional results rather than same-setting performance revisions.

T1.justification: The method equations and FLOP-ratio derivation are unchanged. The same scaling equations move from v2 Appendix F to v4 Section 5.1 with renumbering. No new mathematical definition, theorem, proof or substantive derivation appears.

C1.justification: V4 makes stronger scaling behavior an explicit central contribution in the abstract, introduction and conclusion, highlighting the 17.5% and 24.1% exponent advantages previously reported in Appendix F. The core retrieval-imitation, accuracy and inference-efficiency claims remain.

C2.justification: Appendix H adds the interpretation that MLP Memory combines kNN's long-tail knowledge with the base LM's coherence on frequent function words. Appendices I–J add a performance-efficiency rationale for the eight-layer default. V2's distribution-sharpness and retrieval-compression explanations are retained.

D1.justification: V4 documents initialization from backbone MLP modules, default depth and explicit widths in Appendix I. It clarifies Table 9's unchanged baseline as GPT2-large-CPT. Page 1 supplies code and model access links where v2 promised release upon acceptance; the linked contents themselves are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited-work membership and substantive related-work discussion are retained. Section 6 makes the same comparisons with RAG, memory-augmented language models and all-MLP architectures; citation and bibliography formatting changes do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: V4 moves the scaling section from Appendix F to Section 5.1 and updates the contribution summary and experimental overview accordingly. It removes the short LLM-use and reproducibility statements and adds acknowledgments and appendix subsections. Most existing prose remains closely matched.

P2.justification: V4 adopts a substantially different document-wide template, changing the title block, typography, colored headings, abstract shading, running headers, footer rules and figure/table sizing. The scaling figure moves into the main text, Table 1 expands, and Tables 10–13 are added. Most existing illustrations are reused.

improvement.justification: V4 strengthens comparative support through the kNN-LM QA results and fixed-backbone memory-size ablation, while added initialization, dimension and access information improves reproducibility. The promoted scaling evidence is unchanged, and the new mechanism evidence consists of four illustrative cases. The inconsistent HaluEval dialogue/QA scores between Tables 3 and 5 also persist, so the overall gain is limited.
